headline: Houthi attacks on Abha and King Khalid International airports have killed three civilians and injured 36, according to GACA, and Riyadh flights ran with 15% of departures delayed on Thursday. Aramco Digital announced a second industrial-AI partner in three days (OrbitronAI, after Dell), and stc group signed Cloudera for Kuwait and Bahrain; neither names an infrastructure vendor. Samsung guided a record KRW 107.4tn Q3 operating profit on memory prices, and TrendForce now expects 2027 notebook shipments to fall as CPU, DRAM and SSD reach about 68% of a mainstream notebook's bill of materials. NVIDIA and Microsoft opened RTX Spark AI-PC pre-orders with Lenovo, Dell and HP all launching.
lenovo_read: Aramco Digital is assembling an industrial-AI partner ecosystem quickly and Lenovo is not yet in it; the compute under OrbitronAI's and Dell's offers is the open slot. On devices, lock META AI-PC and workstation deals at today's prices and position RTX Spark and ThinkStation before Dell and HP set the Gulf reference price.

pillars.dc: 3 scored: Nexus AI Factory Morocco (US$1.2bn, hardware undisclosed), Kuwait cloud-DC substations (award likely Q1 2027), CoreWeave–AdaniConneX India (240 MW). No new KSA or GCC build first published in the window.
pillars.memory: 5 scored: Samsung record Q3 guidance (two articles), TrendForce 2027 notebook warning, Surface Ultra pricing on memory costs, Samsung HBM4E qualification, Sigurd test-price hikes. September PC DRAM average $26 (record); spot DDR5 16Gb $58.667 (8 Oct).
pillars.deals: OrbitronAI–Aramco Digital, Cloudera–stc group, Solutions+–Inception42, Toku–Core42, Ooredoo OFN–iQ Networks. No hardware OEM named; no in-window Tadawul ICT disclosure found.
pillars.global: Nokia KSA country manager, Cloudera, NVIDIA/Microsoft RTX Spark, HP, Dell, HPE. Chinese rule: Huawei (Mate XT 2 overseas), Tencent ($5bn bond), status lines for the rest.

stories.title: Three killed, 36 injured in Houthi attacks on Saudi airports, Riyadh says
stories.summary: GACA says three civilians were killed and 36 injured in Houthi-claimed attacks on Abha and King Khalid International airports. The Houthis claim a further strike on Riyadh airport.
bullets: Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority says three civilians were killed and 36 injured in Houthi-claimed attacks on Abha International Airport and King Khalid International Airport
The Abha attack killed two female residents, a Moroccan and an Algerian, and injured 28 others
The Riyadh attack killed a Sudanese citizen and injured eight people, including five Saudi nationals
stories.lenovo: Operating risk for RHQ travel and RUH logistics; resilience becomes a board-level KSA requirement (ISG/SSG continuity offers via account channels only, OPP-061).
stories.arabic: أعلنت الهيئة العامة للطيران المدني مقتل ثلاثة مدنيين وإصابة 36 في هجمات حوثية على مطاري أبها والملك خالد الدولي، ما يرفع أولوية استمرارية الأعمال لدى الجهات السعودية.

stories.title: Riyadh airport flights delayed and cancelled after Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: On 8 Oct, 58 Riyadh departures were delayed (15%) and 11 cancelled; KLM and Air France have suspended Riyadh flights until 24 Oct.
bullets: Flightradar24 showed 58 departures delayed at Riyadh airport as of Thursday morning, 15 per cent of scheduled services
Eleven flights, or 3 per cent, were cancelled, including Saudia SV562 to Dubai and Turkish Airlines TK145 to Istanbul
The airport's disruption index stood at 4.2 out of five, with an average departure delay of 45 minutes
stories.lenovo: Plan RHQ executive travel and inbound ISG shipments around RUH disruption; contingency routing via Dammam and Jeddah.
stories.arabic: تأخرت 15% من رحلات مطار الملك خالد الدولي وأُلغيت 11 رحلة بعد الهجمات الحوثية، مع تعليق شركات طيران أوروبية رحلاتها إلى الرياض.

stories.title: Industrial AI, Saudi Scale: OrbitronAI and Aramco Digital Partner to Unlock Billions
stories.published: 7 Oct 2026, 21:28 KSA (signed early Sept at LEAP, per release)
stories.summary: Aramco Digital and OrbitronAI partner to build, deploy and sell industrial agentic AI on NovaOS. No value disclosed; second Aramco Digital industrial-AI partner in three days after Dell.
bullets: OrbitronAI and Aramco Digital will develop, deploy and commercialize industrial AI agents for asset-heavy industries, targeting multibillion-dollar value pools in capital productivity, supply chain performance and operational execution
The agreement was signed in early September at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh
OrbitronAI's core platform is NovaOS, and the company has more than 50 people across five global offices
stories.lenovo: Hosting and edge compute undisclosed: open ISG opportunity. Co-sell with OrbitronAI on ThinkEdge/ThinkSystem plus Neptune to counter Dell (OPP-068).
stories.arabic: أعلنت أرامكو الرقمية شراكة مع OrbitronAI لوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي الصناعي، وهي ثاني شراكة خلال ثلاثة أيام دون الإفصاح عن مورد البنية الحاسوبية.

stories.title: Cloudera and stc group partner to accelerate digital transformation across the Middle East
stories.summary: stc group and Cloudera partner on hybrid data and AI, delivered through stc Kuwait and stc Bahrain. No value disclosed.
bullets: stc group will coordinate delivery through its subsidiaries stc Kuwait and stc Bahrain, with initial focus on Kuwait and Bahrain
The collaboration covers cybersecurity, network connectivity, IoT and smart city initiatives, governed by a joint steering committee
Ahmed Shakora, General Vice President of META at Cloudera, is quoted; stc group comprises 13 subsidiaries
stories.lenovo: Infrastructure under the Cloudera platform is undisclosed: open ISG opportunity with ThinkSystem/ThinkAgile reference designs for stc Kuwait and Bahrain.
stories.arabic: وقّعت مجموعة stc شراكة مع Cloudera لتسريع التحول الرقمي عبر stc الكويت وstc البحرين دون الإفصاح عن القيمة أو مورد العتاد.

stories.title: We seek a broader partnership with Saudi Arabia in advanced technologies – Taiwan's top envoy
stories.summary: Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-long seeks semiconductor and AI cooperation with Saudi Arabia tied to Vision 2030.
bullets: Foreign Minister Lin Chia-long said Taiwan's economy grew 8.68 percent in 2025, with growth this year projected to exceed 11 percent
Taiwan's stock market is now the fourth largest market in the world by market capitalization
Lin named Saudi Arabia, Oman and Qatar as Middle Eastern countries Taiwan could invest in and cooperate with
stories.lenovo: Taiwanese ODM localisation in KSA would narrow Lenovo's ALAT local-content edge; watch for delegations.
stories.arabic: أكد وزير خارجية تايوان سعي بلاده إلى شراكة أوسع مع المملكة في أشباه الموصلات والذكاء الاصطناعي ضمن رؤية 2030.

stories.title: Nokia appoints Turki Alzwaiml as Country Manager for Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Nokia named Turki Alzwaiml, its Head of Mobile Network Business since 2023, as Country Manager for Saudi Arabia.
bullets: Nokia has appointed Turki Alzwaiml as Country Manager for Saudi Arabia
Alzwaiml has served as Nokia's VP Head of Mobile Network Business since 2023
Mikko Lavanti, Managing Director for Middle East and Africa at Nokia, said Alzwaiml brings extensive experience, strong customer relationships and a deep understanding of the local market
stories.lenovo: New executive at a telco-infrastructure partner and competitor; touchpoint for ThinkEdge with Nokia private 5G.
stories.arabic: عيّنت نوكيا السيد تركي الزويمل مديرًا لأعمالها في المملكة العربية السعودية.

stories.title: FiveNines Group joins US$ 1.2 billion Nexus AI Factory project in Morocco
stories.published: 8 Oct 2026, 11:40 KSA (first: CAJ News 7 Oct 23:17 KSA)
stories.summary: FiveNines Group will lead design and procurement strategy for Nexus's US$1.2bn AI data centre near Casablanca, built to NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 reference architecture.
bullets: FiveNines Group will partner with Nexus to oversee development of a 20 MW data center on the outskirts of Casablanca
The project is backed by a US$ 1.2 billion investment and will come online in two phases through 2027, starting with 16 MW followed by a further 20 MW
The facility aims for a total of 500 MW at full buildout and will use renewable power from TAQA Morocco
stories.lenovo: No server or GPU supplier named: open ISG opportunity for Vera Rubin racks with Neptune; FiveNines is the entry point.
stories.arabic: انضمت FiveNines إلى مشروع مصنع الذكاء الاصطناعي Nexus في الدار البيضاء باستثمار 1.2 مليار دولار دون تحديد مورد الخوادم بعد.

stories.title: Kuwait likely to award cloud data centre substations contract in Q1 2027
stories.summary: MEWRE is expected to award three 132/11kV substations for a cloud data-centre project in Q1 2027 (estimate).
bullets: Kuwait's Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy (MEWRE) is expected to award the contract in the first quarter of 2027, according to a source familiar with the project
The contract covers the supply and installation of three 132/11kV main substations serving a cloud data centre project
stories.lenovo: Sets the power timeline for Kuwait's hyperscale campus and its colocation tenants (OPP-063).
stories.arabic: يُتوقع أن ترسي وزارة الكهرباء الكويتية عقد ثلاث محطات تحويل لمشروع مركز بيانات سحابي خلال الربع الأول من 2027.

stories.title: Solutions+ and Inception42 sign MoU to accelerate Agentic AI Platform Catalyst adoption
stories.summary: Mubadala's Solutions+ and G42's Inception42 signed an MoU at AI Everything to roll out the Catalyst agentic AI platform to UAE government and enterprise.
bullets: The MoU was signed at AI Everything Abu Dhabi 2026, where Solutions+ is a Global Partner
It was signed by Nasir Al Nabhani, Group Managing Director and CEO of Solutions+, and Ashish Koshy, CEO of Inception42, G42's sovereign agentic AI company
Catalyst comprises an Agent Builder, an agent marketplace, a Workflow Builder, the AI Brain reasoning engine and a centralized Command Center
stories.lenovo: Device and on-prem inference layers unassigned; G42-ecosystem signal (OPP-025).
stories.arabic: وقّعت Solutions+ مذكرة تفاهم مع Inception42 لتسريع اعتماد منصة Catalyst للذكاء الاصطناعي الوكيل في الإمارات.

stories.title: Ooredoo's OFN bets on fiber in Iraq to carry Gulf traffic into Europe
stories.summary: Ooredoo Fibre Network signed a dark-fibre deal with iQ Networks to carry FIG cable traffic through Iraq to Turkey and Europe, subject to approvals.
bullets: OFN, Ooredoo Group's international connectivity arm, signed a dark fiber agreement with iQ Networks to carry traffic from its planned Fiber in Gulf (FIG) landing in Iraq onward to Turkey and Europe
FIG is a subsea system linking Qatar, Oman, the UAE, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Iraq
Implementation remains subject to regulatory, governmental and other required approvals
stories.lenovo: Red Sea-avoiding Gulf–Europe route; indirect edge and PoP opportunity. Watch.
stories.arabic: وقّعت شبكة Ooredoo للألياف اتفاقية مع iQ Networks لنقل البيانات من نظام FIG عبر العراق إلى تركيا وأوروبا.

stories.title: Toku to Deploy its AI-powered Customer Experience Platform on Core42 Sovereign Enabled Public Cloud in the UAE
stories.summary: Toku will host its AI customer-experience platform on Core42's Azure-based sovereign public cloud in the UAE.
bullets: The agreement was marked at a signing ceremony in Abu Dhabi on 2 October 2026
Core42's cloud environment currently supports more than 47 Abu Dhabi government entities
Toku's Middle East coverage has grown from two markets to eight since December 2025
stories.lenovo: Core42 sovereign cloud is pulling in ISV tenants (OPP-057); not a direct Lenovo hardware opportunity.
stories.arabic: ستنشر Toku منصتها لتجربة العملاء على السحابة العامة السيادية لـCore42 في الإمارات.

stories.title: NVIDIA, Microsoft Kick Off a New Beginning for Windows PCs With RTX Spark and AI Agents
stories.summary: RTX Spark Windows laptops opened for pre-order, shipping 16 Oct, with Lenovo, Dell, HP and others in the first wave.
bullets: RTX Spark laptops are available for preorder with availability on October 16, and compact desktops go on sale in November
RTX Spark delivers one petaflop of FP4 AI performance and up to 128GB of unified memory
Hardware partners include Acer, ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft, MSI and Gigabyte
stories.lenovo: New premium AI-PC category with Lenovo in the first wave; META launch plan needed before Dell and HP set the Gulf reference (IDG).
stories.arabic: أطلقت NVIDIA ومايكروسوفت حواسيب RTX Spark للطلب المسبق، وتشارك لينوفو في الموجة الأولى.

stories.title: HP Leads the Expansion of the Local AI Era from GB300 AI Workstations to RTX Spark Windows PCs
stories.summary: HP launched RTX Spark OmniBooks from $2,999.99 and demonstrated the ZGX Fury GB300 workstation on Windows.
bullets: The HP OmniBook Ultra 16 is expected on HP.com on October 16, 2026, starting at $3,199.99, and the OmniBook X 14 starts at $2,999.99
Microsoft's event featured the first public demonstration of Windows running on the HP ZGX Fury, built on the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip
Eligible HP consumer devices will get a one-month free trial of Perplexity Pro starting in November 2026
stories.lenovo: Direct IDG competitor in GCC premium and workstation segments; benchmark META pricing.
stories.arabic: أطلقت إتش بي حواسيب OmniBook بمعالجات RTX Spark وعرضت محطة ZGX Fury المبنية على GB300.

stories.title: Dell Technologies Drives the Agentic AI Era with New Windows PCs and Workstations
stories.summary: Dell launched the XPS 16 Creator Edition on RTX Spark and Pro Precision GB300 workstations running models up to 1 trillion parameters locally.
bullets: The XPS 16 Creator Edition offers up to a 6,144-core NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and up to 128GB of unified memory, with pre-orders at Best Buy from October 7
The Dell Creator Edition Desktop delivers up to 1 petaflop of FP4 compute and supports AI models up to 200 billion parameters
Dell Pro Precision with GB300 scales to 20 petaflops of FP4 and 748GB of coherent memory, running models up to 1 trillion parameters locally
stories.lenovo: Dell pairs AI-PC launches with its KSA Aramco Digital push; ThinkStation answer needs META dates now.
stories.arabic: أطلقت ديل حاسوب XPS 16 Creator Edition ومحطات Dell Pro Precision المبنية على GB300.

stories.title: HPE Accelerates Enterprise AI Innovation With Next-Generation AMD CPU-Powered Servers
stories.summary: HPE launched four ProLiant Gen13 servers on AMD EPYC Venice (up to 256 cores), shipping from late 2026 into 2027.
bullets: The HPE ProLiant XD245 is powered by up to eight 6th Gen AMD EPYC processors
The ProLiant DL525 Gen13 is a 1U single-socket system with up to 256 cores, available later in 2026
The ProLiant DL585a Gen13 supports up to eight double-wide PCIe GPUs
stories.lenovo: HPE's next volume-server cycle against ThinkSystem in META refreshes; Venice allocation is a lever.
stories.arabic: أطلقت HPE أول أربعة خوادم ProLiant Gen13 بمعالجات AMD EPYC من الجيل السادس.

stories.title: WSJ: Broadcom seeks over $50 billion for OpenAI chips as Oracle, SpaceX chase AI debt deals
stories.summary: Broadcom seeks over $50bn of financing for OpenAI's custom chip; Oracle explores a chip-leasing vehicle with Apollo and Goldman Sachs.
bullets: Broadcom is working to arrange more than $50 billion in financing for OpenAI's custom AI chip, with Apollo and Blackstone among the lenders approached
Oracle is in talks with Apollo and Goldman Sachs to fund a large chip purchase, likely through a separate entity that would lease the chips to Oracle
SpaceX has discussed a $40 billion financing for Nvidia chips with lenders, as first reported by the FT
stories.lenovo: AI compute moving to lease structures supports the TruScale and Lenovo Financial Services pitch (OPP-055).
stories.arabic: تسعى برودكوم لتمويل يتجاوز 50 مليار دولار لرقائق OpenAI، فيما تبحث أوراكل هيكلًا لاستئجار الرقائق.

stories.title: TSMC's third-quarter revenue surges to record, beating market forecast
stories.summary: TSMC Q3 revenue hit a record NT$1.49tn, up 50% year on year, beating forecasts.
bullets: July-September revenue rose 50% year on year to a record T$1.49 trillion ($46.71 billion), above an LSEG SmartEstimate of T$1.46 trillion
September revenue rose 54.6% year on year to T$511.86 billion
An LSEG SmartEstimate expects third-quarter net profit to rise 64% to T$740.8 billion
stories.lenovo: Leading-edge capacity stays tight for GPU and CPU supply into 2027.
stories.arabic: سجلت TSMC إيرادات قياسية في الربع الثالث بنمو 50% سنويًا بفعل الطلب على رقائق الذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: CoreWeave to collaborate with AdaniConneX to expand AI cloud platform in India
stories.summary: CoreWeave plans 240 MW at AdaniConneX's Navi Mumbai campus as sole tenant, first phase mid-2028.
bullets: CoreWeave plans 240 MW in Navi Mumbai across three 80 MW buildings at AdaniConneX's Taloja campus
CoreWeave will be the sole tenant across the three buildings
The first phase is expected to be available in mid-2028, with further capacity coming online in phases
stories.lenovo: Neoclouds expanding into markets next to META; watch for Gulf entries.
stories.arabic: تخطط CoreWeave لإنشاء 240 ميغاواط من سعة مراكز البيانات في نافي مومباي مع AdaniConneX.

stories.title: Huawei confirms its Mate XT 2 tri-fold smartphone will travel to other regions
stories.summary: Huawei says the Mate XT 2 tri-fold will gradually go on sale overseas; the original launched in South Africa.
bullets: Consumer business chairman Richard Yu said Huawei will gradually make the device available overseas, adding that it is selling very well and demand currently exceeds supply
The Ultimate version has a 10.2in inner display, a 6.5in cover panel, a Kirin 9050 Pro CPU, at least 16GB of RAM and a 5,600mAh battery
The original Mate XT launched in South Africa, and the Mate XT 2 could arrive around March 2027
stories.lenovo: Huawei premium devices returning to META markets compete with Motorola razr (IDG). Included by the Chinese rule.
stories.arabic: أكدت هواوي أن هاتفها Mate XT 2 القابل للطي ثلاثيًا سيُطرح تدريجيًا خارج الصين.

stories.title: Tencent Mulls $5 Billion Bond Offering as AI Push Ramps Up
stories.summary: Tencent is considering an offshore bond of up to $5bn after raising AI and computing capex 176% in the June quarter.
bullets: Tencent is considering an offshore bond sale of as much as $5 billion, which could come as soon as October
In June, Tencent raised nearly $4.7 billion from long-dated dollar and yuan securities, its largest debt offering since 2020
Tencent raised capital expenditure on AI projects and computing by 176% to 52.8 billion yuan ($7.9 billion) in the June quarter
stories.lenovo: More Chinese hyperscale capacity competing for Gulf cloud and AI workloads. Included by the Chinese rule.
stories.arabic: تدرس تينسنت طرح سندات خارجية تصل إلى 5 مليارات دولار لتمويل توسعها في الذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: Samsung Electronics Announces Earnings Guidance for Third Quarter 2026
stories.summary: Samsung guided Q3 sales of about KRW 195tn and a record operating profit of about KRW 107.4tn on memory prices.
bullets: Consolidated sales are approximately 195 trillion Korean won, within a range of 194 to 196 trillion won
Consolidated operating profit is approximately 107.40 trillion Korean won, within a range of 107.3 to 107.5 trillion won
Third quarter 2025 sales were 86.06 trillion won and operating profit 12.17 trillion won, while second quarter 2026 was 171.5 trillion won and 89.49 trillion won
stories.lenovo: Price power stays with memory makers into 2027; every open META quote without indexation is margin at risk (OPP-045/069).
stories.arabic: توقعت سامسونج أرباحًا تشغيلية قياسية تبلغ نحو 107.4 تريليون وون للربع الثالث مدفوعة بأسعار الذاكرة.

stories.title: Samsung's $80.3B quarterly profit set to beat Nvidia and Alphabet's record highs
stories.summary: Samsung's KRW 107.4tn ($80.3bn) OP beat consensus; DRAMeXchange shows a record $26 September PC DRAM average.
bullets: Operating profit of 107.4 trillion won ($80.3 billion) is up 782.5 percent on year and beat the FnGuide consensus of 106 trillion won
Revenue of 195 trillion won rose 126.59 percent but came in slightly below the 200.3 trillion won forecast
Samsung shares fell 1.49 percent to 264,500 won on Thursday
stories.lenovo: Analysts expect server-DRAM upside in Q4; pull META deals forward and lock allocation.
stories.arabic: تجاوزت أرباح سامسونج التوقعات، فيما بلغ متوسط سعر ذاكرة الحواسيب 26 دولارًا في سبتمبر وهو مستوى قياسي.

stories.title: Rising Costs Threaten Notebook Demand in 2027, Raising Risks of Shipment Declines and Price Increases, Says TrendForce
stories.summary: TrendForce forecasts 2027 notebook shipments to fall as CPU, DRAM and SSD reach about 68% of a $900 notebook's BOM.
bullets: TrendForce projects global notebook shipments will fall by a low-single-digit percentage in 2027, widening to the high-single-digit range if component costs are fully passed on to buyers
CPU, DRAM and SSD accounted for approximately 68% of the BOM cost of a US$900 MSRP notebook in 3Q26
Notebook production outside China is estimated to fall from about 24% in 2025 to 21% in 2026, possibly below 20% in 2027
stories.lenovo: Sell price certainty to Q4 closers; index 2027 tranches; ALAT production outside China is a differentiator (IDG).
stories.arabic: حذّرت TrendForce من تراجع شحنات الحواسيب المحمولة في 2027 بسبب ارتفاع تكاليف المعالجات والذاكرة والتخزين.

stories.title: [News] Microsoft Expands Local AI Push With NVIDIA RTX Spark; Surface Ultra Priced Up to $5,899 as Memory Costs Rise
stories.summary: Surface Laptop Ultra tops out at $5,899 with 128 GB memory; DGX Spark 128 GB is 75% above its launch price.
bullets: The Surface Laptop Ultra starts at $2,599 and reaches $5,899 with a 20-core processor, 128 GB of memory and 1 TB of storage
RTX Spark supports up to 128 GB of unified memory and can run models with up to 120 billion parameters locally
NVIDIA's 128 GB DGX Spark now costs $6,950, about 75% above its launch price
stories.lenovo: Benchmark for ThinkStation PGX and RTX Spark pricing in META (OPP-065).
stories.arabic: رفعت تكاليف الذاكرة أسعار حواسيب الذكاء الاصطناعي، إذ ارتفع سعر DGX Spark بنحو 75% عن سعر إطلاقه.

stories.title: Samsung passes qualification tests for HBM4E chips with Nvidia, major hyperscalers
stories.summary: Samsung's 12-layer HBM4E reportedly passed qualification with Nvidia and major hyperscalers.
bullets: Samsung Electronics passed customer qualification tests for its next-generation 12-layer HBM4E chips with Nvidia and major global hyperscalers, according to people familiar with the matter
The approval strengthens Samsung's position against SK Hynix and Micron in next-generation AI memory
stories.lenovo: A second HBM4E source may ease 2027 GPU-server supply at the margin.
stories.arabic: اجتازت رقائق HBM4E من سامسونج اختبارات التأهيل لدى إنفيديا وكبار مزودي الخدمات السحابية.

stories.title: [News] AI Chip Testing Capacity Tightness Prompts Customers to Lock In 1-Year-Plus Deals; Sigurd Hikes Prices
stories.summary: Sigurd is raising AI-chip test prices as customers lock in deals of a year or more; Blackwell test time is four times Hopper's.
bullets: Sigurd has posted monthly revenue above NT$2 billion for three consecutive months
Sigurd raised its 2026 capex to NT$8.8 billion, 48% above its original plan
Citing Nomura, NVIDIA Blackwell's final test time is estimated at four times that of Hopper, while Rubin could take seven times as long
stories.lenovo: Back-end test is a new GPU bottleneck; quote 2027 AI-server lead times conservatively.
stories.arabic: رفعت Sigurd أسعار اختبار رقائق الذكاء الاصطناعي مع شح سعة الاختبار.
